title: Response receipts, practitioner delegation and deadlines
scope: Give each sent response a hashed receipt, let a tax practitioner or Mobile Tax Office officer respond on a taxpayer's behalf with recorded delegation, and show deadlines with extension requests

acceptance.text: Each sent response has a receipt with time and content hash
Delegated responses record who acted for whom and respect tenant scope
Deadlines and extension requests are visible; extensions need officer approval
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

notes.text: Added 2026-11-07 from ADR-043 (Vati downstream of RSL selection; portal answers evidence requests).
